guidebook.role.description.starrailexpre:
Avenger was originally a bodyguard, entrusted by a principal to protect his safety.

But this is a tough job, the Avenger is easy to fail.

If the principal dies, the Avenger will receive a revolver and become a true Avenger.
Meanwhile, if the principal is killed instead of accidentally dying, the Avenger will know the name of the murderer.

Note: Killers and neutrals may also entrust you to protect them.
Can you see through their conspiracy?
